notes.title: ⚠ Ongoing Server Maintenance 30th September 2022 - 30th October 2022 ⚠
notes.notes:
Major server work is now underway and will run until 30th October 2022. Downtime and disruption for Snooker 19’s online features is expected during this time.

For more information regarding this, please visit the [url=https://www.snooker19.com/server-status]Snooker 19 Server Status Page[/url].

[b]⚠ UPDATE 12/10/22: Server Migration ⚠[/b]

From 11 am - 3 pm BST on 12/10/2022 we will be migrating the servers for the Steam version of Snooker 19. 

During this time, the online features of the game will be disrupted. 

This is part of our ongoing server maintenance.

notes.title: Update 1.18 Available Now
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Update 1.18 is now available to download. Please take a look at the notes below to see the fixes and improvements that were part of Update 1.18.

[h1][u][b]Game Update 1.18[/b][/u][/h1]

Snooker 19 game patch that will improve the quality and stability of your experience with Snooker 19 in all modes.

[list]
[*] Game optimisation - faster loading times for all matches in all game modes.
[*] Online Tournaments - changes to ranking and scoring if a match ends prematurely, to protect the integrity of the leaderboards and online competitive play.
[*] Online Tournaments - updated WST tournament calendar.
[*] AI improvements - AI opponents now decide on their next shot more quickly to provide a more immersive and seamless experience.  
[*] Friend Codes - Friend Codes are no longer hidden after returning to the Main Menu if matchmaking fails in Custom Match.
[*] Challenge Mode camera - bug fix for camera movement when aiming in first person.
[*] Various stability improvements -  including for hangs and freezes.
[*] Various bug fixes and improvements - including timeout fouls, referee VO, and new animation transitions.
[/list]

As always, we appreciate your ongoing support and thank you for your patience as we worked to release this update.

notes.title: Server Work and Updates 1.17 and 1.18
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

Hope you're keeping well. We have news to share on upcoming server work and game patches coming to Snooker 19 on Steam and all other platforms.

There is server maintenance planned for the next two days and also two upcoming game updates. We have shared some details below and will keep you posted to confirm when updates go live.

Server Updates 02/09 - 04/09
* Snooker 19 is moving to new servers during this window.
* This may involve downtime.

Game Update 1.17
* Lab42 server security patch, required for the smooth operation of all online servers and modes for Snooker 19 on all platforms.
* Release status: Expected release on PS4 and Steam at 12noon BST on September 2nd. Expected release on XB1 and Nintendo Switch is 12noon BST September 3rd.

Game Update 1.18
* Snooker 19 game patch that will improve the quality and stability of your experience with Snooker 19 in all modes.
* Release status: Currently in early testing cycles, so ETA for release is later this month for all platforms.

In more detail, here's a summary of what you can expect from patch 1.18:

* Game optimisation - faster loading times for all matches in all game modes.
* Online Tournaments - changes to ranking and scoring if a match ends prematurely, to protect the integrity of the leaderboards and online competitive play.
* AI improvements - AI opponents make quicker decisions so that you have a more immersive and seamless experience.
* Various bug fixes and improvements - including fixes for hangs, freezes, timeout fouls, challenge mode camera, referee VO, Friend Codes, and new animation transitions.

Thanks for your patience awaiting these updates and for your continued feedback on the game both here in the community hub and through the feedback form. (You can report any issues using this feedback form: https://forms.gle/8dfoadMnx2JUcVHF7)

We appreciate your support and hope you continue to enjoy Snooker 19 for a long time to come.

Thanks

notes.title: Update 1.16 Available Now
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We hope you are safe and well during this time of uncertainty and we are sending well wishes to all our players across the world.

For those of you playing Snooker 19, we’re happy to share that there’s a new update available for you to download today that makes improvements to online play.

Update 1.16 for Snooker 19 is available now.

Patch notes:

- Online tournament ELO system changes. The base level of points at the start of a tournament will now be set to 750pts instead of 0pts.

- Online tournament rule changes to improve the integrity of online play. A win/loss will now be recorded when a player disconnects once a match is underway, even when the match score is 0-0. The player who disconnects will record a loss.

- Career Mode progress issues addressed

- Cueball default position for break off has been randomised

- "Base to Base" Challenge frame rate improved

- General improvements to online play

As always, thank you for your support and ongoing feedback. Please continue to stay in touch and we'll be monitoring all comments and replies.

Thanks,

Snooker 19 Team

notes.title: Snooker 19 Challenge Pack DLC Available Now
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're excited to share that the Snooker 19 Challange Pack DLC is now available. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1196670/Snooker_19_Challenge_Pack/

This DLC pack invites you to take your best shot and become a better player in a brand new game mode for Snooker 19, adding hours of additional gameplay opportunities. We have created 50 unique challenges to test and improve your skills across positioning, break building, escapes, trick-shot potting puzzles and more, and we can't wait for you to try them out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820802/bfdda011d17bbd52822b4c4fa8a05f838af1903d.jpg[/img]

Challenges are split across two classes; Basic Skills and Advanced Skills, and can be played using a selection of different Aiming Aid difficulties to cater for varying levels of player ability. Master every event and complete all challenge requirements to unlock 26 stylish snooker cue rewards and 5 new achievements exclusive to the Challenge Pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820802/1a1b888a098be9840dd429250402f454fcd2f99a.jpg[/img]

It's great to finally be able to share the Challenge Pack with you, and look forward to hearing your thoughts!

As always, thank you for your support.

Snooker 19 Team

notes.title: Update 1.10 - Available Now
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34820802/c8d931890897cc413c2945217a3c39912098f036.gif[/img]
Hi everyone,

We've been busy working on the next update for Snooker 19 and are happy to share that it is available to download now. As part of Update 1.10 we’ve added new content and improved the game experience based on community feedback, so thank you as always for your ongoing support. 

New Features:

- New Master+ aiming aid added offering a greater challenge than Master
- Added option to reposition the cueball after it has been placed
- Added option to re-nominate a colour after a colour has been nominated
- New player celebration scenes for winning in semi-finals and finals
- Revised intro sequences have been added to Career Mode matches
- Intro sequences have been refined
- Players now chalk their cues during gameplay
- New game intro video added
- Online Tournament aiming aid changed to Pro+ based on player feedback
- Paul Hunter Classic online tournament start date has been brought forward

General Bug fixes, including:

- Commentary and crowd reaction improvements
- Character animation improvements
- Fix for undue “timeout” in long-lasting online matches
- Fix for online tournament trophy cabinet (all Trophies unlocked will now display correctly)
- Baulk line visibility improved
- Scrolling leaderboard issue fixed
- Fix for free-ball when not all the colours are on the table
- Fix for scrolling through free ball options

Please let us know your thoughts as we will be continuing to monitor all feedback, and we hope you enjoy the update. 

Thanks,

Snooker 19 Team

notes.title: Update 1.06 - Available Now
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34820802/eb73198576a711f5780fa5b3f388fc190e077d43.gif[/img]
Update 1.06 is now live and available to download. Thank you for your patience as we worked to make this happen and please continue to share your feedback with us.

You can find more details in regard to the content of Update 1.06 below:

New features

- New online custom match feature. This allows the host to customise match length, arena, and aiming aid.
- New Aiming Aid (Pro+). This is a new aiming aid that is between Pro and Master. Long pots, playing off the cushion and rest play have dynamic aiming aid adjustments to reflect the increased difficulty of these shot types. Available in all modes except Online Tournaments. We have created a thread for you to share your thoughts on the new Pro+ Aiming Aid, so please let us know what you think over on that specific thread in the Community Hub.

Improvements

- AI breakoff variation
- AI potting sequence enhancements
- Career settings. The player can now change match settings during a career.
- Arena lighting improvements
- Snooker table material enhancements
- Character lighting improvements
- Player character idles
- Commentary additions and fixes
- Subtle ball physics amendments to stop the ball more quickly
- Crowd variation - clapping and number of crowd members
- The Legend Reward Pack delivery
- Change to cushion and pocket sounds

Bug fixes

- Fixed several crashes
- Fixed the logic error when AI snookers behind the free ball
- Achievement fixes 
- Rivals icon problem remedied
- Home Nations prize money fix
- Aiming aid issue when in pocket jaws resolved
- Animation bug fixes
- AI fixes
- 6 Red Tournament high score fix
- Added the correct amount of frames for the Shanghai Masters Semi Final
- Commentary fixes
- Fix for rests being used when not required
- Online fix for dark tables
- Touching ball fix
- General Bug fixes

Please keep sharing your feedback with us and we will continue to monitor your responses. 

Thanks for your support,

Snooker 19 Team

notes.title: Enter the Lab42 Open from 28th June - 8th July
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34820802/3bc09047eb9d45ba01d23a09cb3a9f50fa7a620c.jpg[/img]

Good news! The Lab42 Open online tournament starts today and will run until Wednesday 8th July. There are a few key details to be aware of while you play in this tournament regarding ranking, rewards and leaderboards.

[b]REWARDS[/b] 
For this tournament only, everyone taking part in the Lab42 Open will receive all three items from ‘The Legend’ reward set as part of update 1.06. (More details on 1.06 can be found in the Community Hub) The set includes an exclusive bow tie, shirt and waistcoat, so make sure to take part in the tournament over the next week and a half to earn your prizes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34820802/005ca3ce135537b8ae9de96a600b96682b38f94c.png[/img]

[b]LEADERBOARDS[/b] 
We’re investigating reports from players who have lost leaderboard positions and ranking during Online Tournaments. This appears to be quite an obscure issue, so we’re performing tests throughout this tournament so that we can identify and fix the cause of the issue. Your feedback can also help. If you encounter any issues in the Lab 42 Open tournament please complete the short feedback form below. (NB. This is a brand new survey and the results will be used to compare with previous responses. Please still complete the updated survey even if you completed a previous version.) Your support in regard to this issue will help us find and fix the root of the problem for future tournaments.

Tournament Leaderboard Feedback Form: https://www.surveymonkey.co.uk/r/9Y3FC7S

Thanks for your support and good luck in the tournament!

Snooker 19 Team

notes.title: Update 1.03 Available Now
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34820802/c8d931890897cc413c2945217a3c39912098f036.gif[/img]

A new update for Snooker 19 is now available! Thank you for your support as we worked to make this live as quickly as possible. Your feedback has played a massive part in this update and we have addressed a range of reported issues and requests. Full patch notes are below and can also be found as a pinned post in Discussions:

GAMEPLAY
• Online match timers increased
Online vs - match timer: 90 min, shot timer: 60 sec
Online tournament - match timer: 40 min, shot timer: 40 sec
Friend match - match timer: unlimited, shot timer: unlimited
• AI is more aggressive and realistic
• AI safety shots improved
• Player poses improved
• Player hand poses improved
• “Ball hitting the pocket” audio changed to match the strength of the shot

PRESENTATION
• Overall menu navigation improved (selectors are more responsive and controls are improved)
• Shot transition graphic changed from white to blue
• Shot transition time reduced in online matches
• “AI thinking” message appears less often

GENERAL BUG FIXES
• Fixed the bug that caused no miss to be called when snookers required
• Removed rotation of the cue immediately after the white ball has been placed in the D
• Game stability improvements
• Audio lag fixes
• Scrollable Online tournament leaderboard

We have also made changes to the way the online leaderboard collects and records data, after reports from a number of users about issues with leaderboard placement and will continue to monitor this. 

Thank you again for your support and please continue to share your feedback.

Snooker 19 Team

notes.title: Snooker 19 Launches 17th April
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34820802/eb73198576a711f5780fa5b3f388fc190e077d43.gif[/img]

We're incredibly excited to be here bringing you the first announcement about Snooker 19! 

As the official World Snooker videogame, Snooker 19 features all the players and all the drama of the pro snooker tour. That includes all 128 top players, every tournament and three variants of snooker; classic, 6-red and Shoot Out. With an in-depth career mode, online and offline multiplayer and real-time tournaments that sync to the World Snooker calendar; Snooker 19 is the definitive snooker experience.

Thank you for your support as we have worked to prepare for launch this week, we can't wait to share the game with you when it launches tomorrow at 2pm BST for £29.99 / $34.99 / €34.99. 

If you have any questions we will answer as many as we can over in the community hub, so please drop us a message over there.

Thanks,

Snooker 19 Team

[Update 17/04/2019]

There has been a small delay to the 2pm BST scheduled release. We expect this to be resolved quickly. Thanks for your patience and we will keep you updated.
